stock_consumer_evidence.validation: Requires exact record size and nonnull pointer. Interface-kind 1 first gets auth type; cipher mask 0x340 admits 6/8/9 with auth-dependent length clamp 32 or 48, mask 0x6 admits 1/2; other ciphers rejected on this path.
stock_consumer_evidence.dispatch: WCL dispatch, falling back to typed protocol only if unhandled or 0xe082280f
stock_consumer_evidence.limitation: Other interface kinds bypass that cipher filter. This is not proof that the current personal SAE path requires this callback.

stock_producer_evidence.semantics: Core forwards to AppleBCMWLANJoinAdapter::setKey at 0xffffff8001586450 with argument true and null auxiliary data. The setKey jump table distinguishes traffic keys, PMK/MSK (6/9), PMKSA (7) and password (10). Traffic keys map through mapAppleKeyToBcomKey, then runtime-selected async/sync firmware programming. External owner and completion contracts remain unresolved; see docs/development/NATIVE-CONNECTION-AUDIT.md.

join_adapter_dispatch.pmk_6_msk_9: programPMK path; nonempty input with core flag true enables supplicant events and 6000 ms timeout
join_adapter_dispatch.pmksa_7: feature/logging branch returns success without programPMK or data-key installation in this exact build
join_adapter_dispatch.password_10: separate credential path, not a data-key install
join_adapter_dispatch.other_types: mapAppleKeyToBcomKey then firmware programming; mapping may reject unsupported types
join_adapter_dispatch.limitation: Producer dispatch reconstructed; caller state ownership and host-supplicant interoperability remain pending
